title: Ops Lane: Weekly Traffic & Readiness Brief
body:
Purpose:
Quick, scannable weekly brief for product ops owners to see traffic trends, launch readiness, and immediate blockers. This is a working doc (not final) — use as the single source for the ops standup on Mondays.

Snapshot (week ending 2024-12-01):
- Prod requests: 2.4M (↑ 18% wk) — driven by Hosted API expansion in EU-west region.
- Median p95 latency (text-gen): 140ms (goal 125ms) — slight regress on medium-length prompts.
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted tier): $0.78 (↓ 4% with batching changes)
- Embedding units: 480k (stable)
- Error rate (5xx): 0.9% (target <0.5%) — spikes during canary on 11/29 22:00 UTC

Top KPIs to watch this week:
1) Latency SLO compliance (p95 under 150ms) — current: 92% of routes meet threshold.
2) Error budget burn (monthly) — current burn: 7% of monthly error budget.
3) New customer onboarding success (first 7 days retention) — cohort Nov-20: 64%
4) Cost variance vs baseline (dedicated pools) — Nov weekly variance: +3.6%
5) Canary failure rate (traffic diverted) — last canary: 2.3% failures on heavy prompt path

Readiness checklist (for upcoming EU-dedicated rollout on 2024-12-10):
- [x] Finalize capacity plan for gpupos-eu-1 (platform-eng done)
- [x] SLA doc reviewed by legal & sales (sales-ok, legal pending two lines)
- [ ] Canary schedule set and owner assigned (need SRE confirmation)
- [ ] Access playbook updated for customer ops (TODO: add runbook links)
- [x] Model pinlist approved (v1.4 pinned, fallback v1.3)
- [ ] Data residency signoff for EUDC customers (waiting on compliance)

Owners & on-call contacts:
- Launch owner: Aisha Patel (Slack: @aisha)
- SRE lead (canary + rollback): Jonah Reed (Slack: @jonah-sre)
- Capacity & infra: Eric Morales (Slack: @eric-infra)
- Customer ops (post-launch issues): Sana Iqbal (Slack: @sana-cs)
- Legal/compliance reviewer: Priya Desai (Slack: @priya-legal)

Recent incidents / blockers:
- 2024-11-29 22:00 UTC: Canary routed 5% of traffic to v1.4; observed 5xx spike at 22:12-22:18. Root cause: mem pressure on gpupos-3 baseline; mitigation: scaled pool and throttled large-context requests. Postmortem draft: CONFLUENCE-INC-332 (link above).
- Access issue: Two customer accounts missing region-binding flags — blocker for three early adopters. Action: Customer ops to patch via admin API (owner: Sana).

Risk heatmap (short bullets):
- High: Compliance signoff delay could block private deployment signups in EU (impact: revenue + customer trust).
- Medium: Latency regression for medium prompts — might require kernel tune or revert batching.
- Low: Minor config drift in autoscaler thresholds on dedicated pools.

Action items (this sprint) — owners + ETA:
- Jonah: Confirm canary schedule and runbook by 2024-12-03.
- Eric: Add gpupos-eu-2 reserve capacity and update capacity dashboard by 2024-12-05.
- Sana: Reach out to affected customers and confirm region flags by 2024-12-04.
- Aisha: Coordinate legal signoff meeting (Priya) and escalate if no response by 2024-12-06.

Metrics tracker (quick table summary, numbers are snapshot, more detailed sheet in Confluence):
- Route: /v1/text-gen — p95: 170ms, throughput: 420 req/s, errors: 0.7%
- Route: /v1/chat — p95: 120ms, throughput: 340 req/s, errors: 0.5%
- Route: /v1/embeddings — p95: 85ms, throughput: 220 req/s, errors: 0.2%

Notes to SRE & Platform Eng:
- If medium-prompt p95 stays above 160ms next two days, schedule emergency kernel revert window (preferable overnight UTC).
- Confirm autoscaler cooldown doesn't exceed 45s for dedicated pools serving high QPS endpoints.

Stakeholder nudges (short):
- Sales: please freeze new EU Dedicated commitments until we have compliance signoff or mark them as "pending compliance" in CRM.
- Support: prepare templated messages for affected customers if we need scheduled maintenance on 12/09-12/10.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we allow temporary increased error budget for first two weeks post-launch to prioritize stability fixes? (Pro: reduces immediate rollbacks; Con: customer impact) — Decision owner: product-ops leadership.
- Is rollback automated on canary failure or manual? Current plan: automatic to fallback model v1.3 if error rate >2% for 10min, pending Jonah confirmation.

Quick historical context (for new readers):
- This doc started as a weekly operations glance in Q2 2023; evolved into the launch brief for region rollouts. Use it for Monday standups and for handoffs during on-call rotations.

How to use this doc:
- Edit live in Drive before Monday 09:00 PT. Add rapid notes under Recent incidents. Keep action items concise with owner + ETA.

Appendix (links & references):
- Full KPI sheet (detailed): Confluence Ops Metrics -> Weekly KPI Grid
- Canary runbook: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/runbooks/canary.md
- Postmortem draft: CONFLUENCE-INC-332

Last quick check: Are we aligned on go/no-go for EU-dedicated launch on 2024-12-10? Current state: Conditional go (missing legal/compliance signoff and canary schedule).

— Aisha
